## AKCA v0.3.1

This release brings the discovery, verification, and reporting changes made after v0.3.0 into the tagged source and downloadable builds.

### Highlights

- Complete crawling and a unified GET/POST hidden-parameter pass before vulnerability checks. Exclude unavailable routes and static resources from inappropriate active payload tests.
- Run injection checks before noisier path and access-control checks, and avoid repeating completed SQLi/XSS work in follow-up passes.
- Assess PHP2Shell on explicit origins in normal full scans with bounded active memory-signature checks. Unknown exposure is inconclusive; a memory-exhaustion signature is a candidate, not proof of code execution.
- Tighten SQLi timing, route authentication, OAST, and report proof gates. Findings without current, class-specific evidence remain manual review leads.
- Refresh the self-contained HTML report with a centered AKCA logo, larger text, clearer summary and finding sections, and readable HTTP request/response evidence.

### Verification and limits

Full Go package tests, `go vet`, formatting, the strict observed benchmark gate, and report layout previews passed locally. A 360-pixel mobile stress preview showed no horizontal overflow. These checks do not establish zero false positives or complete validation of every module against live targets. The scanner must be used only on systems you own or are authorized to test.

### Downloads

The release workflow publishes Windows x64, Linux x64/ARM64, and macOS Intel/Apple Silicon executables, `SHA256SUMS.txt`, and GitHub build provenance attestations. The source tag for Go installation is `engine/v0.3.1`:

```bash
go install github.com/akha-security/akca/engine/cmd/akca@v0.3.1
```

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/akha-security/akca/compare/v0.3.0...v0.3.1
